# E0336: a remap is not remap(source path, table)

remap takes two arguments: a reference into the source instance, and a table
of `value: value` arms, with an optional `[_]` catch-all.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	kind: 1 | 2
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		kind: remap(v0_0.kind)
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0336]: remap takes two arguments: remap(v0_0.<path>, {...})
 --> 1.0.thema:8:9
  |
8 |         kind: remap(v0_0.kind)
  |               ^^^^^
  |
```
